title: A hymn to Agni for protection and prosperity

verses.t: Whithersoe'er, from sky, earth, air's mid-regions from plants ands herbs, from tall trees, Jātavedas. Is carried here and there to divers places, even thence come thou to us with loving-kindness.
All majesty of thine in floods, in forest, in plants, in cattle, in the depths of waters Closely uniting all thy forms, O Agni, come unto us wealth-giving, undecaying.
Thy majesty among the Gods in Svarga, thy body which hath past into the Fathers. Thy plenty far-diffused mid human beings, even with this, O Agni, give us riches.
To him the wise, the famous, swift to listen, with words and verses I come nigh for bounty. May we be safe from threatening danger. Soften by sacrifice the- wrath of Gods, O Agni.
